test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

She is going to serve tea in silver cups today.

options.text: Tea will be served in silver cups today.
Tea will have been served in silver cups today.
Tea is going to be served in silver cups today.
Tea should be served in silver cups today.

solution:
The correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• *​*The **subject **of the **Active Voice** is changed into the **object **of the **Passive voice**. Also, the **object **of the **Active Voice** is changed into the **subject **of the **Passive Voice**.
 
• The usage of a **helping verb** is necessary while changing the voice of the sentence from **Active to Passive**.
 
• The Active voice in this question is in Present Continuous Tense. Thus, the Passive voice will also be in the Present Continuous Tense.
 
• The format of **Active voice** is: **Subject + is/am/are+ v1+ ing + object**__
 
• Thus, in **Passive voice**, the format will be: **__Object+ is/am/are+ being+ V3+ by + subject__**
 
• **For example:**
 
 
• *Esha is singing a song.* (Active Voice)
 
• *A song is being sung by Esha.* (Passive Voice)
 
 

The options except for **option (3)** don’t follow the correct grammatical format of the Passive Voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Tea is going to be served in silver cups today.**
